prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures the chaotic energy of a theatre backstage. On the far left stands a tall man in a velvet cape, holding a silver mirror while checking his reflection. Next to him sits a small wooden crate, upon which rests a frayed top hat. In the center foreground, a woman in a sequined dress points urgently at a torn script held by a nervous stagehand in suspenders. The stagehand looks down at the paper, his brow furrowed in concentration. To the right of the stagehand, an old prop sword leans against a stack of dusty crates. Behind the sword, a large brown dog sleeps peacefully on a pile of costumes. A young girl in a ballet tutu stands next to the dog, gently stroking its fur. Above them, hanging from the ceiling rigging, is a single bare lightbulb that casts soft shadows. On the far right, a makeup artist in a white coat hands a powder puff to a clown with exaggerated red cheeks. The clown looks at the puff with wide eyes, ready to apply more paint. Near the clown’s feet lies a discarded banana peel. There is no audience visible in this private moment. There is no bright sunlight streaming through windows, only the dim interior glow.
